Class XmlStructSerializer<T>

Namespace
ShapeEngine.Serialization
Assembly
ShapeEngine.dll

Provides XML serialization and deserialization for value types (structs) using XmlSerializer.

public class XmlStructSerializer<T> where T : struct

Type Parameters

T

The value type to serialize/deserialize. Must be a struct.

Remarks

This class is designed for types that are structs (value types). It omits the XML namespace declaration and uses UTF-8 encoding without BOM. The class supports both instance and static usage for serialization and deserialization.
